classification.summary: The xToken contracts registered in Swarm's XTokenWrapper exposed mint(address,uint256) with no MINTER_ROLE check, so anyone could mint xDAI/xUSDC and redeem them through XTokenWrapper.unwrap() for the wrapper's real DAI and USDC.

loss.notes: Migrated from legacy lossUsd/lossOther. The legacy corpus did not consistently distinguish gross from net loss or record valuation provenance.

limitations: Target identity and code history came from the v1 snapshot row originally at protocols/swarm-markets.json; no semantic revalidation was inherited.
The executing code artifact and its code hash have not been established in structured evidence.

sources.note: onchain review: xToken 0xD08E245Fdb3f1504aea4056e2C71615DA7001440 created 2024-01-25T05:11:11Z by Swarm deployer 0x959e2cc532115d0a86e24eb2977d93df6202560e (also the creator of the second drained xToken 0x0a3fbF5B4cF80DB51fCAe21efe63f6a36D45d2B2), neither the attacker nor the attack-tx sender; its verified source has an unguarded `function mint(address account, uint256 amount) external { _mint(account, amount); }` and hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, attacker) is false, confirming no role was needed. No EIP-1967 events, code immutable since deployment. The cited transaction was submitted by MEV searcher 0xc0ffeebabe5d496b2dde509f9fa189c25cf29671, who front-ran the original exploiter 0x38f68f119243adbca187e1ef64344ed475a8c69c; ~7,729 in DAI+USDC drained from XTokenWrapper 0x2b9dc65253c035Eb21778cB3898eab5A0AdA0cCe.

limitations: Classification and loss came from the v1 snapshot row originally at protocols/swarm-markets.json; legacy measurement.status=OK is provenance only.
The legacy USD loss lacks uniformly structured valuation provenance.
